summary: StudentAssessments is a user control in an ASP.NET web application for managing and displaying student placement assessments, including generating and downloading assessment reports. It allows filtering by course and assessment template, displays a grid of assessments, supports combined views of assessments, and handles report generation and download in CSV format.
purpose: To facilitate the retrieval, display, and reporting of student placement assessments. Provides users (students and staff) the ability to filter assessments by course and template, view assessment statuses, and generate downloadable reports.

workflows.name: Page Load and Initial Data Binding
steps: On initial page load (not postback), set ViewState[FirstDataLoad] to '1'.
If UserSession is set and FirstDataLoad, call Refresh(true) and update FirstDataLoad to '0'.

workflows.name: Refresh and Filtering
steps: Set report generation button visibility based on ScreenIsEditable.
FillCourseDropdown to populate course filter with PlacementRequestAssessments for the student.
FillAssessmentTemplateDropdown to populate assessment template filter with templates for the student.
If student user and staff ID matches StudentID and a course is selected, enable combined view if interim or final assessment is 'Submitted'.
If no sort expression for gridData, default sort by 'Course'.
DisplayGrid binds the data if required.

workflows.name: Grid Data Binding & Row Customization
steps: Handle gridData_RowDataBound to adjust row appearance, progress icons, hyperlinks, and status descriptions based on assessment state.
Show/hide action links (Open, View, Closed) and icons based on status codes, dates, and type codes.
Alternate row styling with CSS class logic.

workflows.name: Report Generation and Download
steps: On btnGenerateReport_Click: assemble report context, query assessment data, generate CSV report via ReportMain.OutputCSV.
Show report in lblReportHTML, set hdnFileName for download.
If report is a CSV provide download link (lnkDownloadFile) with constructed file name.
On lnkDownloadFile_Click: handle actual download via ReportMain.DownloadFile.

workflows.name: Dropdown and Sorting Actions
steps: Sort buttons for Date, Assessment, Type, Course trigger gridData sorting.

business_rules: Students can only view assessments where their StaffID matches StudentID.
Combined view enabled only if interim or final assessment status is 'Submitted'.
Report generation available only when screen is editable.
Dropdown for courses and templates is populated based on student's available assessments/templates, including retired templates.
Sort operations default to 'Course' if none set.
validations: UserSession must be set for any report or data operation.
Assessment grid data source selection canceled if UserSession is null.
Dropdown values are reset or defaulted if no valid data found.
CSV filename is sanitized using MakeValidFileName.
calculations: CSV reports are dynamically generated based on selected course, template, and student info.
File name includes template, student details, and course information.
conditions: Combined view button visible only if interim/final assessment submitted.
Hyperlinks enabled based on assessment statuses and dates.
Grid row styling varies based on row state and assessment period.
system_behavior: Page loads with initial filter values, hides report panel.
Dropdowns and grid refresh based on user actions.
Grid rows display action buttons/icons and status messages contextually.
Report HTML is shown after report generation, file download enabled if CSV.
Sorts and filters are applied contextually based on user and assessment state.
dependencies: ReportMain.OutputCSV and DownloadFile (for CSV report generation/download).
Dropdown utility methods for selection, current ID.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, grid data source selection is canceled.
If no report is generated or filename does not end with .csv, download link is hidden.
If assessment data is missing or incomplete, dropdowns default to 'All'.
content_gaps: Exact assessment field definitions and mapping details are not present.
Complete UI markup and template configuration details missing.
Report output formatting specifics are not detailed.
No error handling specified for report generation failures.
